# Therapy Group of DC

> > Expert mental health therapy services in Washington DC since 2003, specializing in anxiety, depression, trauma, couples therapy, and life transitions with evidence-based treatments.

Therapy Group of DC is a full-service therapy practice located in Dupont Circle, Washington DC, offering both in-person and online therapy. The practice provides specialized treatment for anxiety disorders, depression, trauma/PTSD, couples therapy, career counseling, and LGBTQ+ affirming care using evidence-based approaches including CBT, psychodynamic therapy, EMDR, EFT, and ACT.

## Key Topics

- Anxiety therapy
- Depression treatment
- Trauma and PTSD
- Couples and marriage counseling

- Psychodynamic therapy
- LGBTQ+ affirming care
- Career counseling

- Burnout therapy
- Washington DC
- Dupont Circle
- Therapist matching
